release_notes:
• AI Vision Food Classifier: Integrated real-time on-device ML Vision to accurately distinguish food from non-food objects. Photos of carpets, floors, furniture, and electronics are now detected and prevented from false logging.
• High-accuracy food recognition for meals, snacks, and beverages with instant calorie estimation
• Front-Page Streak Challenge Module with customizable day targets (1d, 3d, 7d, 10d, 14d, 30d)
• Visual meal photo journal & camera scanning directly from Diary
